content.value: Air is contained in a vertical piston-cylinder assembly fitted with an electric resistor. The ( 11) atmosphere exerts a pressure of I atrn on the top of the piston, which has a mass of45 kg and a face area of 0.1 m<sup>2•</sup> Electric current passes through a resistor, and the volume of the air slowly increases by 0.051113 while its pressure remains constant. The mass of the air is 0.3kg and its specific internal energy increases by 42kJ/kg. The air and the piston arc at rest initially and finally. The piston-cylinder material is a ceramic composite and thus a good insulator. Friction between the piston and cylinder wall can be ignored, and local acceleration of gravity is 9.8m/s2• Determine the heat transfer from the resistor to the air for a system consisting of the air alone.
